'''Blackarm''' was an informal tribal title given to the strongest member of a [[kamen]], a group of two to forty [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] of the [[kolkpravis]], the Kaleesh [[Species/Legends|species']] [[Army/Legends|army]].<ref name="GaW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The title of blackarm was introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GaW" />
